title: Tuning finalist, 400 epochs: 16 units × 2, dropout 0.1, learning rate 0.01
description: Finalist round of the hyperparameter search: at 150 epochs many runs were still improving, so the best grid configurations and the previous network are trained again with a 400-epoch limit (batch 64), 3 seeds. Same data and network as the tuning run HT_u16_l2_d10_lr01; chosen by session-1 validation loss only. Training windows are fed in time order (no shuffling).
